focusStateEnumeration._method: Every one of the 34 built component sets enumerated from the Figma file, then crossed against source for whether the component takes keyboard focus. CAPTURE ONLY — closing the gaps is a follow-up batch.
focusStateEnumeration._globalRule: THE KEY FINDING, and it reframes the whole list: focus is styled GLOBALLY, not per component. CssBaselineOverrides.ts:8 sets `*:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid theme.palette.primary.main }` and line 12 sets `*:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none }`. So every focusable element in the system gets a 3px Growth 1 #004852 outline on keyboard focus without its own override doing anything. A component set missing a Focus visible variant is therefore missing a state the theme already gives it — the gap is in Figma, not in the code.

_componentSpecificFocusRules.MenuItemOverrides.ts:7: &.Mui-focusVisible — white background, 3px solid primary.main BORDER, radius 4. Replaces the ring look rather than adding to it.
_componentSpecificFocusRules.AutocompleteOverrides.tsx:17: .MuiAutocomplete-option.Mui-focusVisible — identical treatment to MenuItem: white background, 3px solid primary.main border, radius 4.
_componentSpecificFocusRules.ButtonGroupOverrides.ts:47: &:focus { zIndex: 2 } with the comment 'Increase z-index on Button focus to ensure outline is shown in case hidden under a sibling button'. Not a focus visual — it is direct evidence that the GLOBAL outline is expected on Button group segments and had to be rescued from overlap.
_componentSpecificFocusRules.ButtonOverrides.ts:15: &:focus appears only inside a grouped `boxShadow: none` rule. NOT a focus visual.

fieldFocusNotFocusRing.note: Field-level focus (notch + outline colour), a different concept from the focus-visible ring. Not counted as a gap.

Tooltip.whatIsKnown: Tooltip was raised in the feedback batch. The specific was not supplied.
Tooltip.whyNothingWasBuilt: The note does not identify a property, state or value. Arrow, placement chrome, a Tebra-palette ground, and a size/multiline treatment are all consistent with an unspecified tooltip note and would each produce a different component, so building any of them would be a guess presented as a transcription.
Tooltip.currentTruth: The built Tooltip is unchanged and remains the correct transcription of MUI substrate: alpha(grey[700], 0.92) ground bound to color/computed (no palette)/tooltipBackground, radius 4, padding 4/8, maxWidth 300, common.white text at pxToRem(11) bound to 11, fontWeightMedium 500 shipping Regular because Akkurat LL has no Medium. No arrow — the story never sets it. Placement is runtime: the story's only argType is placement with 12 options defaulting to 'bottom', and placement moves the popper, not the surface.
Tooltip.markedInFigma: Feedback page, Tooltip component description carries a PENDING DESIGNER CLARIFICATION paragraph pointing back at this entry.
Tooltip.unblockedBy: A specific from Daniel naming the property and the intended value.
